I replied to Ilse in a thread on her message in #north-random. I confirmed the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is 10 June and that this replaces the date she posted in #north-team this morning.

I also told her I don't keep a separate record of my own. If the rest of the team needs the right date, she'll have to edit her #north-team post or add a note there. I didn't read or change anything in #north-team, since she said no action was needed.

The renewal date is account information, not a money figure, and Ilse posted it in this channel herself, so it was fine to repeat it there.
